title: Clinical and Radiological Outcomes Following Orbital Floor Revision: A Comparative Analysis of Fracture Configurations and Surgical Approaches
summary: Ziel dieser Studie ist die Evaluation verschiedener operativer Verfahren anhand ihrer postoperativen Ergebnisse. Neben klinischen Parametern, insbesondere Motilitäts- und Sensibilitätsstörungen, werden auch radiologische Befunde mit besonderem Fokus auf die Bulbusverlagerung systematisch untersucht.

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients who underwent surgical revision of the orbital floor between January 2020 and January 2026.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The inclusion criteria comprised a radiologically confirmed orbital floor fracture, treatment during the study period, postoperative imaging, and adequate clinical documentation in the patient’s medical records.
Exclusion criteria:
The exclusion criteria included incomplete radiological or clinical documentation, as well as missing data on key examination parameters.
